integrity_note: The ten finite certificates are exactly reproducible using a standard-library checker; finite checks are not substituted for the published infinite 3-GDD existence theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only length-three centers, length-two descendants, exactly one deletion, even alphabet size at least two.
Finite optimal codebooks are provided as complete witness data; no classification of all optima is claimed.
Infinite existence uses the published Colbourn–Hoffman–Rees 3-GDD theorem rather than a self-contained proof of that theorem.
Independent literature-priority and mathematical validation are not claimed.
title: Exact length-three one-deletion covering over every even alphabet
